title: Buckets
about: Storage for models, datasets and checkpoints. Every object carries the address of its own bytes.

inventory.note: a bucket is an OCI index tree under /v2/, named buckets/{owner}/{name}. There is no separate bucket API.

catalog_note: no catalogue object yet: discovery is the registry catalogue filtered by the buckets/ prefix

list.returns: every repository; the buckets are those named buckets/{owner}/{name}
every past state; a tag h-{milliseconds} is one publish and names its parent

item.returns: the bucket as it stands, an OCI index

verify.expected_from: the catalog, the tree listing or the manifest -- never the source that served the bytes
verify.privacy: a private bucket is encrypted in the browser before anything is sent, object names included; the hub stores bytes it cannot read
